name: Image Editor
descriptionForPeople: Draw, crop and save copies of images. Removing a background is a paid operation, priced in Compute.
descriptionForModel: Edit an image document; strokes and crops are saved as a new copy. Removing the background from one or more selected images is a paid operation that first shows a plan card with an estimate and a maximum, then runs under an allowance.

operations.name: Open
operations.descriptionForModel: Open an image asset as a document.

operations.name: Apply
operations.descriptionForModel: Apply a stroke, crop or reset to the open document.

operations.name: PrepareSave
operations.descriptionForModel: Prepare a save ticket for the current revision.

operations.name: CompleteSave
operations.descriptionForModel: Complete a prepared save with the stored file.

operations.name: RemoveBackground
operations.descriptionForModel: Remove the background from the selected images. This is paid: it shows a plan for the selected images with an estimate and a maximum, and runs only under an allowance.

examplePrompts: Remove the background from these 3 product photos
